_comment: RTT vocabulary corrections. Seeded 2026-07-13 from 227 old-model (ConversationTranscriber) transcripts. Two rule kinds: 'literal' = unconditional whole-word/phrase replacement (safe only when the wrong form never occurs legitimately in your meetings). 'guarded' = replace only when one of `near` context words appears within the same line (for garbles whose wrong form IS a real word, e.g. 'fire'). Case-insensitive match; replacement casing is preserved as written here. Rebuild from real new-model transcripts as gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize garbles differ.
